package bountyforge

	realmAddr = chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g10yuqyktt4777jn8rt3nmuhw4suz9mvypaec7ac/bountyforge")

	sponsor   = testutils.TestAddress("sponsor")

	alice     = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob       = testutils.TestAddress("bob")
	carol     = testutils.TestAddress("carol")

func depositToEscrow(ugnot int64) {
	coins := chain.Coins{chain.NewCoin("ugnot", ugnot)}
	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr, coins)
	testing.SetOriginSend(coins)
}

type fakeBanker struct{}

func (fakeBanker) SendCoins(address, address, chain.Coins) {}
func (fakeBanker) TotalCoin(string) int64                  { return 0 }
func (fakeBanker) IssueCoin(address, string, int64)        {}

func Test01_FullLifecycleApproveAndReputation(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()

	depositToEscrow(5_000_000)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	id := CreateBounty(
		cross(cur),
		"Build Gno Indexer",
		"Deliver deterministic ABCI indexer with unit tests",
		"gno,indexer",
		arbiter.String(),
		100,
	)
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(1), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(5_000_000), TotalEscrowed())

	// Sponsor tops up with +1.5 GNOT.
	depositToEscrow(1_500_000)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	newTotal := TopUpBounty(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(6_500_000), newTotal)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(6_500_000), TotalEscrowed())

	// Alice submits work, then updates her proof URL cleanly without duplicating.
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	idx1 := SubmitWork(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/LHorTL/bountyforge/pull/1", "Draft")
	idx2 := SubmitWork(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/LHorTL/bountyforge/pull/2", "All tests passing")
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, idx1)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, idx2)

	b := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	beforeAlice := b.GetCoin(alice, "ugnot")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	ApproveAndPay(cross(cur), id, 0)

	afterAlice := b.GetCoin(alice, "ugnot")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(6_500_000), afterAlice-beforeAlice)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), TotalEscrowed())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(6_500_000), TotalPaidOut())
	uassert.True(t, BuilderXP(alice) >= 100, "alice should earn Apprentice XP on 6.5 GNOT")

	// Verify all gnoweb routes render cleanly with valid /r/...: links (ZERO leading-colon links!).
	home := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "Build Gno Indexer"), "home should list bounty")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "<gno-columns>"), "home should use gno-columns KPIs")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "<gno-button "), "home should include gno-button CTAs")
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(home, "](:"), "must NEVER emit broken leading-colon links")

	detail := Render("bounty/1")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "6.5 GNOT"), "detail should show reward")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "On-Chain Settlement"), "detail should show settlement")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "Crowdfund Escrow Ledger"), "detail should show sponsor ledger")
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(detail, "](:"), "detail must NEVER emit leading-colon links")

	lb := Render("leaderboard")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(lb, alice.String()), "leaderboard should include alice")
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(lb, "](:"), "leaderboard must NEVER emit leading-colon links")

	prof := Render("builder/" + alice.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(prof, "Apprentice"), "profile should show Apprentice tier")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(prof, "data:image/svg+xml;base64,"), "profile should embed on-chain SVG badge")

	stats := Render("stats")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(stats, "Cumulative Paid"), "stats should render")

	createForm := Render("new")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(createForm, `<gno-form exec="CreateBounty">`), "new route should render gno-form")
}

func Test02_SplitAndPayZeroDustAndSVGChart(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()

	depositToEscrow(1_000_003)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	id := CreateBounty(cross(cur), "Co-Authored Package", "Split across two builders", "gno,split", "", 0)

	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	SubmitWork(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/alice", "Core module")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	SubmitWork(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/bob", "Test suite")

	b := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	aBefore := b.GetCoin(alice, "ugnot")
	bBefore := b.GetCoin(bob, "ugnot")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	SplitAndPay(cross(cur), id, "0,1", "6667,3333")

	aGot := b.GetCoin(alice, "ugnot") - aBefore
	bGot := b.GetCoin(bob, "ugnot") - bBefore
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_000_003), aGot+bGot)
	uassert.True(t, aGot > bGot, "alice gets majority + dust")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), TotalEscrowed())

	detail := Render("bounty/1")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "66.67%"), "pure integer FormatBPS")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "data:image/svg+xml;base64,"), "multi-contributor split renders SVG chart")
}

func Test08_DisputeTimeoutEscapeHatchDeadArbiter(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()

	depositToEscrow(3_000_000)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	id := CreateBounty(cross(cur), "Dead Arbiter Test", "Verify escape hatch", "sec", arbiter.String(), 100)

	depositToEscrow(1_000_000)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	TopUpBounty(cross(cur), id)

	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	SubmitWork(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/work", "done")
	OpenDispute(cross(cur), id, "stalled")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "bountyforge: dispute has not timed out yet", func() {
		ExpireDispute(cross(cur), id)
	})

	testing.SkipHeights(DisputeTimeoutBlocks + 1)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "bountyforge: only a contributor or active submitter can expire a timed-out dispute", func() {
		ExpireDispute(cross(cur), id)
	})

	b := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	cBefore := b.GetCoin(creator, "ugnot")
	sBefore := b.GetCoin(sponsor, "ugnot")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	ExpireDispute(cross(cur), id)

	uassert.Equal(t, int64(3_000_000), b.GetCoin(creator, "ugnot")-cBefore)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_000_000), b.GetCoin(sponsor, "ugnot")-sBefore)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), TotalEscrowed())
}

func Test10_DeadlineAndReviewGraceWindowEnforced(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()

	depositToEscrow(1_000_000)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	id := CreateBounty(cross(cur), "Grace Window Test", "Verify deadline + review grace", "sec", "", 20)

	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	SubmitWork(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/pr", "submitted in time")

	testing.SkipHeights(21)

	// Late submission rejected after DeadlineH
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "bountyforge: submission deadline has passed", func() {
		SubmitWork(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/late", "too late")
	})

	// Creator cannot cancel during ReviewGraceBlocks
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "bountyforge: cannot cancel while submissions exist before deadline + review grace", func() {
		CancelAndRefund(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// After ReviewGraceBlocks passes, creator can cancel cleanly
	testing.SkipHeights(ReviewGraceBlocks + 1)
	CancelAndRefund(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), TotalEscrowed())
}

func Test19_AVLLeaderboardOrderingPaginationAndClamping(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()

	rewards := []struct {
		builder address
		amt     int64
	}{
		{bob, 2_000_000},
		{carol, 10_000_000},
		{alice, 5_000_000},
	}
	for i, tc := range rewards {
		depositToEscrow(tc.amt)
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
		id := CreateBounty(cross(cur), "Quest "+strconv.Itoa(i+1), "Desc", "gno", "", 0)
		testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(tc.builder))
		SubmitWork(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/"+strconv.Itoa(i), "done")
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
		ApproveAndPay(cross(cur), id, 0)
	}

	lbPage1 := Render("leaderboard?page=1&size=2")
	carolPos := strings.Index(lbPage1, carol.String())
	alicePos := strings.Index(lbPage1, alice.String())

}

package nandloom

import "gno.land/p/nt/ufmt/v0"

// DefaultChallenges returns the 8 progressive NAND-to-4-Bit-Adder challenges.
// Every test vector is deterministic and capped at <= 64 vectors for bounded gas.
func DefaultChallenges() []ChallengeSpec {
	return []ChallengeSpec{
		{
			ID:         "not1",
			Title:      "Inverter (NOT)",
			Summary:    "Invert a single bit using universal NAND logic.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 1 · Foundations",
			Inputs:     []string{"a"},
			Outputs:    []string{"y"},
			ParNANDs:   1,
			ParDepth:   1,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "0->1"},
				{In: []bool{true}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "1->0"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in a\nout y\ny = nand(a, a)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "and2",
			Title:      "2-Input AND",
			Summary:    "Output 1 only when both a and b are 1. Try reusing chip:not1_ref.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 1 · Foundations",
			Inputs:     []string{"a", "b"},
			Outputs:    []string{"y"},
			ParNANDs:   2,
			ParDepth:   2,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "00"},
				{In: []bool{false, true}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "01"},
				{In: []bool{true, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "10"},
				{In: []bool{true, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "11"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in a, b\nout y\nw = nand(a, b)\ny = chip:not1_ref(w)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "or2",
			Title:      "2-Input OR",
			Summary:    "Output 1 when either a or b is 1 via De Morgan's law.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 1 · Foundations",
			Inputs:     []string{"a", "b"},
			Outputs:    []string{"y"},
			ParNANDs:   3,
			ParDepth:   2,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "00"},
				{In: []bool{false, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "01"},
				{In: []bool{true, false}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "10"},
				{In: []bool{true, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "11"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in a, b\nout y\nna = chip:not1_ref(a)\nnb = chip:not1_ref(b)\ny = nand(na, nb)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "xor2",
			Title:      "2-Input XOR",
			Summary:    "Output 1 when inputs differ. Can be solved cleanly in 4 NANDs.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 2 · Gates",
			Inputs:     []string{"a", "b"},
			Outputs:    []string{"y"},
			ParNANDs:   4,
			ParDepth:   3,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "00"},
				{In: []bool{false, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "01"},
				{In: []bool{true, false}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "10"},
				{In: []bool{true, true}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "11"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in a, b\nout y\nw1 = nand(a, b)\nw2 = nand(a, w1)\nw3 = nand(b, w1)\ny = nand(w2, w3)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "mux2",
			Title:      "2-to-1 Multiplexer",
			Summary:    "Route a when sel=0 and b when sel=1. Optimal design uses 4 NANDs.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 2 · Routing",
			Inputs:     []string{"sel", "a", "b"},
			Outputs:    []string{"y"},
			ParNANDs:   4,
			ParDepth:   3,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false, false, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "s0:0,0"},
				{In: []bool{false, false, true}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "s0:0,1"},
				{In: []bool{false, true, false}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "s0:1,0"},
				{In: []bool{false, true, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "s0:1,1"},
				{In: []bool{true, false, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "s1:0,0"},
				{In: []bool{true, false, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "s1:0,1"},
				{In: []bool{true, true, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "s1:1,0"},
				{In: []bool{true, true, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "s1:1,1"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in sel, a, b\nout y\nnsel = nand(sel, sel)\nw1 = nand(a, nsel)\nw2 = nand(b, sel)\ny = nand(w1, w2)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "half_adder",
			Title:      "Half Adder",
			Summary:    "Add two 1-bit values into (sum, carry). Composing XOR+AND takes 6 NANDs; sharing nand(a,b) beats it in 5 NANDs.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 3 · Arithmetic",
			Inputs:     []string{"a", "b"},
			Outputs:    []string{"sum", "carry"},
			ParNANDs:   5,
			ParDepth:   3,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false, false}, Out: []bool{false, false}, Label: "0+0"},
				{In: []bool{false, true}, Out: []bool{true, false}, Label: "0+1"},
				{In: []bool{true, false}, Out: []bool{true, false}, Label: "1+0"},
				{In: []bool{true, true}, Out: []bool{false, true}, Label: "1+1"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in a, b\nout sum, carry\nsum = chip:xor2_ref(a, b)\ncarry = chip:and2_ref(a, b)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "full_adder",
			Title:      "Full Adder",
			Summary:    "Add a + b + cin into (sum, cout). Composing two half-adders + OR takes 13-15 NANDs; shared NAND logic reaches 9 NANDs.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 3 · Arithmetic",
			Inputs:     []string{"a", "b", "cin"},
			Outputs:    []string{"sum", "cout"},
			ParNANDs:   9,
			ParDepth:   6,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false, false, false}, Out: []bool{false, false}, Label: "0+0+0"},
				{In: []bool{false, false, true}, Out: []bool{true, false}, Label: "0+0+1"},
				{In: []bool{false, true, false}, Out: []bool{true, false}, Label: "0+1+0"},
				{In: []bool{false, true, true}, Out: []bool{false, true}, Label: "0+1+1"},
				{In: []bool{true, false, false}, Out: []bool{true, false}, Label: "1+0+0"},
				{In: []bool{true, false, true}, Out: []bool{false, true}, Label: "1+0+1"},
				{In: []bool{true, true, false}, Out: []bool{false, true}, Label: "1+1+0"},
				{In: []bool{true, true, true}, Out: []bool{true, true}, Label: "1+1+1"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in a, b, cin\nout sum, cout\ns1, c1 = chip:half_adder_ref(a, b)\nsum, c2 = chip:half_adder_ref(s1, cin)\ncout = chip:or2_ref(c1, c2)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "adder4",
			Title:      "4-Bit Ripple Carry Adder",
			Summary:    "Compose four full adders to add two 4-bit integers + carry-in across 64 exhaustive & carry-chain test vectors.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 4 · Composite Silicon",
			Inputs:     []string{"a0", "a1", "a2", "a3", "b0", "b1", "b2", "b3", "cin"},
			Outputs:    []string{"s0", "s1", "s2", "s3", "cout"},
			ParNANDs:   36,
			ParDepth:   12,
			Vectors:    buildAdder4Vectors(),
			StarterNetlist: "in a0, a1, a2, a3, b0, b1, b2, b3, cin\n" +
				"out s0, s1, s2, s3, cout\n" +
				"s0, c1 = chip:full_adder_ref(a0, b0, cin)\n" +
				"s1, c2 = chip:full_adder_ref(a1, b1, c1)\n" +
				"s2, c3 = chip:full_adder_ref(a2, b2, c2)\n" +
				"s3, cout = chip:full_adder_ref(a3, b3, c3)",
		},
	}
}

func makeAdder4Vec(a, b, cin int, label string) TestVector {
	sum := a + b + cin
	in := []bool{
		(a & 1) != 0, (a & 2) != 0, (a & 4) != 0, (a & 8) != 0,
		(b & 1) != 0, (b & 2) != 0, (b & 4) != 0, (b & 8) != 0,
		cin != 0,
	}
	out := []bool{
		(sum & 1) != 0, (sum & 2) != 0, (sum & 4) != 0, (sum & 8) != 0,
		(sum & 16) != 0,
	}
	return TestVector{In: in, Out: out, Label: label}
}

func buildAdder4Vectors() []TestVector {
	// 16 hand-picked corner & carry-ripple cases + 48 deterministic spread cases = 64 vectors.
	corners := [][3]int{
		{0, 0, 0},
		{0, 0, 1},
		{15, 0, 1},  // full 4-bit carry ripple
		{0, 15, 1},  // symmetric full carry ripple
		{15, 15, 0}, // max without cin
		{15, 15, 1}, // max with cin
		{5, 10, 0},  // alternating bits 0101 + 1010 = 1111
		{5, 10, 1},  // alternating bits ripple overflow
		{10, 5, 1},
		{8, 8, 0},   // MSB carry out
		{7, 1, 0},   // mid-chain ripple
		{7, 8, 1},
		{1, 14, 1},
		{3, 12, 1},
		{9, 6, 1},
		{12, 7, 0},
	}
	vecs := make([]TestVector, 0, 64)
	seen := make(map[int]bool, 64)
	for i := 0; i < len(corners); i++ {
		a, b, c := corners[i][0], corners[i][1], corners[i][2]
		key := (a << 5) | (b << 1) | c
		seen[key] = true
		vecs = append(vecs, makeAdder4Vec(a, b, c, ufmt.Sprintf("%d+%d+%d", a, b, c)))
	}
	// Deterministic LCG sweep across the remaining 9-bit space.
	state := 137
	for len(vecs) < 64 {
		state = (state*73 + 29) & 511
		if seen[state] {
			continue
		}
		seen[state] = true
		a := (state >> 5) & 15
		b := (state >> 1) & 15
		c := state & 1
		vecs = append(vecs, makeAdder4Vec(a, b, c, ufmt.Sprintf("%d+%d+%d", a, b, c)))
	}
	return vecs
}

// DefaultReferenceChips returns starter verified chips ordered by dependency so
// a freshly deployed realm immediately has a live composable library.
// Deliberately uses composable naive designs for half_adder_ref (6 NANDs),
// full_adder_ref (15 NANDs), and adder4_ref (60 NANDs) so builders can beat
// the records on day one with optimized shared-NAND architectures.
func DefaultReferenceChips() []ReferenceChip {
	return []ReferenceChip{
		{
			ChallengeID: "not1",
			Slug:        "not1_ref",
			Title:       "Reference Inverter",
			Notes:       "Ties both NAND inputs together for a 1-gate NOT.",
			Netlist:     "in a\nout y\ny = nand(a, a)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "and2",
			Slug:        "and2_ref",
			Title:       "Reference AND2",
			Notes:       "NAND followed by chip:not1_ref.",
			Netlist:     "in a, b\nout y\nw = nand(a, b)\ny = chip:not1_ref(w)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "or2",
			Slug:        "or2_ref",
			Title:       "Reference OR2",
			Notes:       "De Morgan OR built by importing chip:not1_ref twice.",
			Netlist:     "in a, b\nout y\nna = chip:not1_ref(a)\nnb = chip:not1_ref(b)\ny = nand(na, nb)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "xor2",
			Slug:        "xor2_ref",
			Title:       "Reference 4-NAND XOR",
			Notes:       "Classic 4-gate balanced NAND XOR.",
			Netlist:     "in a, b\nout y\nw1 = nand(a, b)\nw2 = nand(a, w1)\nw3 = nand(b, w1)\ny = nand(w2, w3)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "mux2",
			Slug:        "mux2_ref",
			Title:       "Reference 2:1 MUX",
			Notes:       "4-NAND multiplexer with inverted select line.",
			Netlist:     "in sel, a, b\nout y\nnsel = chip:not1_ref(sel)\nw1 = nand(a, nsel)\nw2 = nand(b, sel)\ny = nand(w1, w2)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "half_adder",
			Slug:        "half_adder_ref",
			Title:       "Composed Half Adder (6 NAND)",
			Notes:       "Composes chip:xor2_ref + chip:and2_ref (6 NANDs). Beat it in 5 NANDs by sharing nand(a,b).",
			Netlist:     "in a, b\nout sum, carry\nsum = chip:xor2_ref(a, b)\ncarry = chip:and2_ref(a, b)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "full_adder",
			Slug:        "full_adder_ref",
			Title:       "Composed Full Adder (15 NAND)",
			Notes:       "Chains two chip:half_adder_ref + chip:or2_ref. Beat it down to 9 NANDs.",
			Netlist:     "in a, b, cin\nout sum, cout\ns1, c1 = chip:half_adder_ref(a, b)\nsum, c2 = chip:half_adder_ref(s1, cin)\ncout = chip:or2_ref(c1, c2)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "adder4",
			Slug:        "adder4_ref",
			Title:       "4-Bit Ripple Adder (60 NAND)",
			Notes:       "Ripples carry across four imported chip:full_adder_ref blocks. Beat it with optimized sub-chips.",
			Netlist: "in a0, a1, a2, a3, b0, b1, b2, b3, cin\n" +
				"out s0, s1, s2, s3, cout\n" +
				"s0, c1 = chip:full_adder_ref(a0, b0, cin)\n" +
				"s1, c2 = chip:full_adder_ref(a1, b1, c1)\n" +
				"s2, c3 = chip:full_adder_ref(a2, b2, c2)\n" +
				"s3, cout = chip:full_adder_ref(a3, b3, c3)",
		},
	}
}

package nandloom

import "gno.land/p/nt/ufmt/v0"

// DefaultChallenges returns the 8 progressive NAND-to-4-Bit-Adder challenges.
// Every test vector is deterministic and capped at <= 64 vectors for bounded gas.
func DefaultChallenges() []ChallengeSpec {
	return []ChallengeSpec{
		{
			ID:         "not1",
			Title:      "Inverter (NOT)",
			Summary:    "Invert a single bit using universal NAND logic.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 1 · Foundations",
			Inputs:     []string{"a"},
			Outputs:    []string{"y"},
			ParNANDs:   1,
			ParDepth:   1,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "0->1"},
				{In: []bool{true}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "1->0"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in a\nout y\ny = nand(a, a)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "and2",
			Title:      "2-Input AND",
			Summary:    "Output 1 only when both a and b are 1. Try reusing chip:not1_ref.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 1 · Foundations",
			Inputs:     []string{"a", "b"},
			Outputs:    []string{"y"},
			ParNANDs:   2,
			ParDepth:   2,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "00"},
				{In: []bool{false, true}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "01"},
				{In: []bool{true, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "10"},
				{In: []bool{true, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "11"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in a, b\nout y\nw = nand(a, b)\ny = chip:not1_ref(w)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "or2",
			Title:      "2-Input OR",
			Summary:    "Output 1 when either a or b is 1 via De Morgan's law.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 1 · Foundations",
			Inputs:     []string{"a", "b"},
			Outputs:    []string{"y"},
			ParNANDs:   3,
			ParDepth:   2,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "00"},
				{In: []bool{false, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "01"},
				{In: []bool{true, false}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "10"},
				{In: []bool{true, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "11"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in a, b\nout y\nna = chip:not1_ref(a)\nnb = chip:not1_ref(b)\ny = nand(na, nb)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "xor2",
			Title:      "2-Input XOR",
			Summary:    "Output 1 when inputs differ. Can be solved cleanly in 4 NANDs.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 2 · Gates",
			Inputs:     []string{"a", "b"},
			Outputs:    []string{"y"},
			ParNANDs:   4,
			ParDepth:   3,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "00"},
				{In: []bool{false, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "01"},
				{In: []bool{true, false}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "10"},
				{In: []bool{true, true}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "11"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in a, b\nout y\nw1 = nand(a, b)\nw2 = nand(a, w1)\nw3 = nand(b, w1)\ny = nand(w2, w3)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "mux2",
			Title:      "2-to-1 Multiplexer",
			Summary:    "Route a when sel=0 and b when sel=1. Optimal design uses 4 NANDs.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 2 · Routing",
			Inputs:     []string{"sel", "a", "b"},
			Outputs:    []string{"y"},
			ParNANDs:   4,
			ParDepth:   3,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false, false, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "s0:0,0"},
				{In: []bool{false, false, true}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "s0:0,1"},
				{In: []bool{false, true, false}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "s0:1,0"},
				{In: []bool{false, true, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "s0:1,1"},
				{In: []bool{true, false, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "s1:0,0"},
				{In: []bool{true, false, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "s1:0,1"},
				{In: []bool{true, true, false}, Out: []bool{false}, Label: "s1:1,0"},
				{In: []bool{true, true, true}, Out: []bool{true}, Label: "s1:1,1"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in sel, a, b\nout y\nnsel = nand(sel, sel)\nw1 = nand(a, nsel)\nw2 = nand(b, sel)\ny = nand(w1, w2)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "half_adder",
			Title:      "Half Adder",
			Summary:    "Add two 1-bit values into (sum, carry). Composing XOR+AND takes 6 NANDs; sharing nand(a,b) beats it in 5 NANDs.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 3 · Arithmetic",
			Inputs:     []string{"a", "b"},
			Outputs:    []string{"sum", "carry"},
			ParNANDs:   5,
			ParDepth:   3,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false, false}, Out: []bool{false, false}, Label: "0+0"},
				{In: []bool{false, true}, Out: []bool{true, false}, Label: "0+1"},
				{In: []bool{true, false}, Out: []bool{true, false}, Label: "1+0"},
				{In: []bool{true, true}, Out: []bool{false, true}, Label: "1+1"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in a, b\nout sum, carry\nsum = chip:xor2_ref(a, b)\ncarry = chip:and2_ref(a, b)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "full_adder",
			Title:      "Full Adder",
			Summary:    "Add a + b + cin into (sum, cout). Composing two half-adders + OR takes 13-15 NANDs; shared NAND logic reaches 9 NANDs.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 3 · Arithmetic",
			Inputs:     []string{"a", "b", "cin"},
			Outputs:    []string{"sum", "cout"},
			ParNANDs:   9,
			ParDepth:   6,
			Vectors: []TestVector{
				{In: []bool{false, false, false}, Out: []bool{false, false}, Label: "0+0+0"},
				{In: []bool{false, false, true}, Out: []bool{true, false}, Label: "0+0+1"},
				{In: []bool{false, true, false}, Out: []bool{true, false}, Label: "0+1+0"},
				{In: []bool{false, true, true}, Out: []bool{false, true}, Label: "0+1+1"},
				{In: []bool{true, false, false}, Out: []bool{true, false}, Label: "1+0+0"},
				{In: []bool{true, false, true}, Out: []bool{false, true}, Label: "1+0+1"},
				{In: []bool{true, true, false}, Out: []bool{false, true}, Label: "1+1+0"},
				{In: []bool{true, true, true}, Out: []bool{true, true}, Label: "1+1+1"},
			},
			StarterNetlist: "in a, b, cin\nout sum, cout\ns1, c1 = chip:half_adder_ref(a, b)\nsum, c2 = chip:half_adder_ref(s1, cin)\ncout = chip:or2_ref(c1, c2)",
		},
		{
			ID:         "adder4",
			Title:      "4-Bit Ripple Carry Adder",
			Summary:    "Compose four full adders to add two 4-bit integers + carry-in across 64 exhaustive & carry-chain test vectors.",
			Difficulty: "Tier 4 · Composite Silicon",
			Inputs:     []string{"a0", "a1", "a2", "a3", "b0", "b1", "b2", "b3", "cin"},
			Outputs:    []string{"s0", "s1", "s2", "s3", "cout"},
			ParNANDs:   36,
			ParDepth:   12,
			Vectors:    buildAdder4Vectors(),
			StarterNetlist: "in a0, a1, a2, a3, b0, b1, b2, b3, cin\n" +
				"out s0, s1, s2, s3, cout\n" +
				"s0, c1 = chip:full_adder_ref(a0, b0, cin)\n" +
				"s1, c2 = chip:full_adder_ref(a1, b1, c1)\n" +
				"s2, c3 = chip:full_adder_ref(a2, b2, c2)\n" +
				"s3, cout = chip:full_adder_ref(a3, b3, c3)",
		},
	}
}

func makeAdder4Vec(a, b, cin int, label string) TestVector {
	sum := a + b + cin
	in := []bool{
		(a & 1) != 0, (a & 2) != 0, (a & 4) != 0, (a & 8) != 0,
		(b & 1) != 0, (b & 2) != 0, (b & 4) != 0, (b & 8) != 0,
		cin != 0,
	}
	out := []bool{
		(sum & 1) != 0, (sum & 2) != 0, (sum & 4) != 0, (sum & 8) != 0,
		(sum & 16) != 0,
	}
	return TestVector{In: in, Out: out, Label: label}
}

func buildAdder4Vectors() []TestVector {
	// 16 hand-picked corner & carry-ripple cases + 48 deterministic spread cases = 64 vectors.
	corners := [][3]int{
		{0, 0, 0},
		{0, 0, 1},
		{15, 0, 1},  // full 4-bit carry ripple
		{0, 15, 1},  // symmetric full carry ripple
		{15, 15, 0}, // max without cin
		{15, 15, 1}, // max with cin
		{5, 10, 0},  // alternating bits 0101 + 1010 = 1111
		{5, 10, 1},  // alternating bits ripple overflow
		{10, 5, 1},
		{8, 8, 0},   // MSB carry out
		{7, 1, 0},   // mid-chain ripple
		{7, 8, 1},
		{1, 14, 1},
		{3, 12, 1},
		{9, 6, 1},
		{12, 7, 0},
	}
	vecs := make([]TestVector, 0, 64)
	seen := make(map[int]bool, 64)
	for i := 0; i < len(corners); i++ {
		a, b, c := corners[i][0], corners[i][1], corners[i][2]
		key := (a << 5) | (b << 1) | c
		seen[key] = true
		vecs = append(vecs, makeAdder4Vec(a, b, c, ufmt.Sprintf("%d+%d+%d", a, b, c)))
	}
	// Deterministic LCG sweep across the remaining 9-bit space.
	state := 137
	for len(vecs) < 64 {
		state = (state*73 + 29) & 511
		if seen[state] {
			continue
		}
		seen[state] = true
		a := (state >> 5) & 15
		b := (state >> 1) & 15
		c := state & 1
		vecs = append(vecs, makeAdder4Vec(a, b, c, ufmt.Sprintf("%d+%d+%d", a, b, c)))
	}
	return vecs
}

// DefaultReferenceChips returns starter verified chips ordered by dependency so
// a freshly deployed realm immediately has a live composable library.
// Deliberately uses composable naive designs for half_adder_ref (6 NANDs),
// full_adder_ref (15 NANDs), and adder4_ref (60 NANDs) so builders can beat
// the records on day one with optimized shared-NAND architectures.
func DefaultReferenceChips() []ReferenceChip {
	return []ReferenceChip{
		{
			ChallengeID: "not1",
			Slug:        "not1_ref",
			Title:       "Reference Inverter",
			Notes:       "Ties both NAND inputs together for a 1-gate NOT.",
			Netlist:     "in a\nout y\ny = nand(a, a)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "and2",
			Slug:        "and2_ref",
			Title:       "Reference AND2",
			Notes:       "NAND followed by chip:not1_ref.",
			Netlist:     "in a, b\nout y\nw = nand(a, b)\ny = chip:not1_ref(w)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "or2",
			Slug:        "or2_ref",
			Title:       "Reference OR2",
			Notes:       "De Morgan OR built by importing chip:not1_ref twice.",
			Netlist:     "in a, b\nout y\nna = chip:not1_ref(a)\nnb = chip:not1_ref(b)\ny = nand(na, nb)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "xor2",
			Slug:        "xor2_ref",
			Title:       "Reference 4-NAND XOR",
			Notes:       "Classic 4-gate balanced NAND XOR.",
			Netlist:     "in a, b\nout y\nw1 = nand(a, b)\nw2 = nand(a, w1)\nw3 = nand(b, w1)\ny = nand(w2, w3)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "mux2",
			Slug:        "mux2_ref",
			Title:       "Reference 2:1 MUX",
			Notes:       "4-NAND multiplexer with inverted select line.",
			Netlist:     "in sel, a, b\nout y\nnsel = chip:not1_ref(sel)\nw1 = nand(a, nsel)\nw2 = nand(b, sel)\ny = nand(w1, w2)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "half_adder",
			Slug:        "half_adder_ref",
			Title:       "Composed Half Adder (6 NAND)",
			Notes:       "Composes chip:xor2_ref + chip:and2_ref (6 NANDs). Beat it in 5 NANDs by sharing nand(a,b).",
			Netlist:     "in a, b\nout sum, carry\nsum = chip:xor2_ref(a, b)\ncarry = chip:and2_ref(a, b)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "full_adder",
			Slug:        "full_adder_ref",
			Title:       "Composed Full Adder (15 NAND)",
			Notes:       "Chains two chip:half_adder_ref + chip:or2_ref. Beat it down to 9 NANDs.",
			Netlist:     "in a, b, cin\nout sum, cout\ns1, c1 = chip:half_adder_ref(a, b)\nsum, c2 = chip:half_adder_ref(s1, cin)\ncout = chip:or2_ref(c1, c2)",
		},
		{
			ChallengeID: "adder4",
			Slug:        "adder4_ref",
			Title:       "4-Bit Ripple Adder (60 NAND)",
			Notes:       "Ripples carry across four imported chip:full_adder_ref blocks. Beat it with optimized sub-chips.",
			Netlist: "in a0, a1, a2, a3, b0, b1, b2, b3, cin\n" +
				"out s0, s1, s2, s3, cout\n" +
				"s0, c1 = chip:full_adder_ref(a0, b0, cin)\n" +
				"s1, c2 = chip:full_adder_ref(a1, b1, c1)\n" +
				"s2, c3 = chip:full_adder_ref(a2, b2, c2)\n" +
				"s3, cout = chip:full_adder_ref(a3, b3, c3)",
		},
	}
}

package questmaster

import (
	"chain/runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/g1llc3lq3zmjtjdk29dk52munrzxt5ne746cl7r8/escrow"
	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

const base = "/r/g1llc3lq3zmjtjdk29dk52munrzxt5ne746cl7r8/questmaster"

func has(t *testing.T, page, want, what string) {
	t.Helper()
	if !strings.Contains(page, want) {
		t.Fatalf("%s: page does not contain %q\n--- page ---\n%s", what, want, page)
	}
}

func hasNot(t *testing.T, page, bad, what string) {
	t.Helper()
	if strings.Contains(page, bad) {
		t.Fatalf("%s: page must not contain %q\n--- page ---\n%s", what, bad, page)
	}
}

// renders calls Render and fails the test (instead of crashing) on a panic.
func renders(t *testing.T, path string) string {
	t.Helper()
	var out string
	if r := revive(func() { out = Render(path) }); r != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Render(%q) panicked: %v", path, r)
	}
	return out
}

var allPaths = []string{
	"", "?page=2", "help", "paid", "paid?page=2",
	"quest/1", "quest/2", "quest/3", "quest/4", "quest/5", "quest/6",
	"poster/" + alice.String(), "builder/" + bob.String(), "poster/" + bob.String() + "?page=2",
}

func TestRenderEmptyBoard(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	for _, p := range allPaths {
		renders(t, p)
	}
	home := renders(t, "")
	has(t, home, "# QuestMaster", "home title")
	has(t, home, "| 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |", "empty totals")
	has(t, home, "No open quests right now.", "empty list")
	has(t, home, "[Post the first one]("+base+"$help&func=PostQuest&.send=1000000ugnot)", "post link with send")
	has(t, renders(t, "paid"), "No quest has been paid yet.", "empty paid")
	has(t, renders(t, "poster/"+alice.String()), "No quests yet.", "empty poster")
	has(t, renders(t, "quest/1"), "# Not found", "no quest 1 yet")
}

// board builds a board with quests in every state and more than one page of
// open quests. Known numbers:
//
//	1 Paid (approved, 2 GNOT)       2 Paid (timeout, 3 GNOT)
//	3 Cancelled (1.5 GNOT)          4 Claimed by bob
//	5 Submitted by bob              6 Open after one reject
//	7..31 Open (25 quests, 1 GNOT each)
func board(cur realm) {
	resetState()
	a := submitted(cur, 2*gnot)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	ApproveWork(cross(cur), a)

	b := submitted(cur, 3*gnot)
	testing.SkipHeights(escrow.ReviewBlocks + 1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	ClaimPayout(cross(cur), b)

	c := post(cur, alice, 1_500_000, "Cancelled quest")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	CancelQuest(cross(cur), c)

	claimed(cur, 4*gnot)
	submitted(cur, 5*gnot)

	f := submitted(cur, 6*gnot)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	RejectWork(cross(cur), f, "Please add tests")

	for i := 0; i < 25; i++ {
		post(cur, carol, gnot, "Small task")
	}
}

func TestRenderFullBoard(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	board(cur)
	for _, p := range allPaths {
		renders(t, p)
	}
	home := renders(t, "")
	// open: 6 + 25 = 26; locked: 4+5+6+25 = 40; paid 2+3 = 5; 2 quests paid
	has(t, home, "| 26 | 40 | 5 | 2 |", "totals")
	uassert.Equal(t, PageSize, strings.Count(home, "](/r/g1llc3lq3zmjtjdk29dk52munrzxt5ne746cl7r8/questmaster:quest/"), "first page holds PageSize quests")
	has(t, home, "| 31 | [Small task]("+base+":quest/31) | 1 GNOT | 2,000 (about 117 minutes) | 0 |", "newest first")
	has(t, home, "Page 1 of 2 · [Older →]("+base+"?page=2)", "next link")
	hasNot(t, home, "Newer", "no prev link on page 1")

	p2 := renders(t, "?page=2")
	uassert.Equal(t, 6, strings.Count(p2, "](/r/g1llc3lq3zmjtjdk29dk52munrzxt5ne746cl7r8/questmaster:quest/"), "second page")
	has(t, p2, "| 6 | [claimed quest]("+base+":quest/6) | 6 GNOT | 2,000 (about 117 minutes) | 1 |", "rejected quest shows count")
	has(t, p2, "Page 2 of 2 · [← Newer]("+base+"?page=1)", "prev link")
	has(t, renders(t, "?page=3"), "This page is empty.", "past the end")

	paid := renders(t, "paid")
	has(t, paid, "2 quests, 5 GNOT in total", "paid summary")
	has(t, paid, "| 2 | [claimed quest]("+base+":quest/2) | 3 GNOT | "+userLink(bob, false)+" | 0 |", "paid row")

	poster := renders(t, "poster/"+alice.String())
	has(t, poster, "| 3 | [Cancelled quest]("+base+":quest/3) | 1.5 GNOT | Cancelled (refunded) | - |", "cancelled row")
	has(t, poster, "| 4 | [claimed quest]("+base+":quest/4) | 4 GNOT | Claimed (work in progress) |", "claimed row")
	builder := renders(t, "builder/"+bob.String())
	// builder history keeps quest 6 although bob was rejected
	has(t, builder, "| 6 | [claimed quest]("+base+":quest/6) | 6 GNOT | Open |", "history row")
	has(t, builder, "| 1 | [claimed quest]("+base+":quest/1) | 2 GNOT | Paid |", "paid in history")
	has(t, renders(t, "poster/"+carol.String()+"?page=2"), "Page 2 of 2", "poster page 2")
}

func TestRenderQuestStates(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	board(cur)
	open := renders(t, "quest/7")
	has(t, open, "| State | **Open** |", "open state")
	has(t, open, "**Claim**", "claim step")
	has(t, open, "[Open in gnoweb]("+base+"$help&func=ClaimQuest&id=7)", "claim link")
	has(t, open, "[Open in gnoweb]("+base+"$help&func=CancelQuest&id=7)", "cancel link")
	has(t, open, `-pkgpath "gno.land/r/g1llc3lq3zmjtjdk29dk52munrzxt5ne746cl7r8/questmaster" -func "ClaimQuest" -args "7"`, "gnokey claim")

// User text must never become Markdown structure. These asserts pin the exact
// escaped output for every dangerous character.
func TestRenderInjection(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	title := "# A | `c` [x](y) ![i](z) <script> * _ ) @alice"
	details := "Line one\n# not a heading\n- not a list\n| a | b |\n|---|---|\n<script>alert(1)</script>\n![img](https://e.vil/i.png) [link](https://e.vil)\nsee g1jg8mtutu9khhfwc4nxmuhcpftf0pajdhfvsqf5 and @bob\n===\n\n\n    indented"
	id := postD(cur, alice, gnot, title, details)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	ClaimQuest(cross(cur), id)
	SubmitWork(cross(cur), id, "https://e.vil/a_(b)<c>`d`|e")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	RejectWork(cross(cur), id, "Bad\n## heading\n[x](https://e.vil) <b>")

	// second quest keeps the hostile link visible
	id2 := postD(cur, alice, gnot, "Link test", "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	ClaimQuest(cross(cur), id2)
	SubmitWork(cross(cur), id2, "https://e.vil/a_(b)<c>`d`|e")

	escTitle := "\\# A | \\`c\\` \\[x\\]\\(y\\) \\!\\[i\\]\\(z\\) \\<script\\> \\* \\_ \\) \\@alice"
	escCellTitle := strings.ReplaceAll(escTitle, "|", "\\|")

	q := renders(t, "quest/1")
	has(t, q, "# Quest 1: "+escTitle+"\n", "title in heading")
	has(t, q, "> Line one  \n> \\# not a heading  \n> \\- not a list  \n> \\| a \\| b \\|  \n> \\|\\-\\-\\-\\|\\-\\-\\-\\|  \n"+
		"> \\<script\\>alert\\(1\\)\\</script\\>  \n> \\!\\[img\\]\\(https://e\\.vil/i\\.png\\) \\[link\\]\\(https://e\\.vil\\)  \n"+
		"> see g1jg8mtutu9khhfwc4nxmuhcpftf0pajdhfvsqf5 and \\@bob  \n> \\===  \n>\n> indented  \n", "details block")
	has(t, q, "> Bad  \n> \\#\\# heading  \n> \\[x\\]\\(https://e\\.vil\\) \\<b\\>  \n", "reason block")

	home := renders(t, "")
	has(t, renders(t, "poster/"+alice.String()), "| 2 | [Link test]("+base+":quest/2) |", "plain title")
	has(t, home, "| 1 | ["+escCellTitle+"]("+base+":quest/1) |", "title in table cell")

	q2 := renders(t, "quest/2")
	// ( ) < > ` | are percent-encoded in the target; the visible text is the
	// escaped URL itself
	has(t, q2, "| Work | [https://e\\.vil/a\\_\\(b\\)\\<c\\>\\`d\\`\\|e](https://e.vil/a_%28b%29%3Cc%3E%60d%60%7Ce) |", "hostile link made safe")
	hasNot(t, q2, "](https://e.vil/a_(", "no raw parenthesis in a link target")
	has(t, q2, "_No details given._", "empty details")

	for _, page := range []string{q, q2, home} {
		hasNot(t, page, "<script>", "raw script tag")
		hasNot(t, page, "![", "unescaped image")
		hasNot(t, page, "\n#  ", "stray heading")
		hasNot(t, page, " @alice", "raw mention")
		hasNot(t, page, " g1jg8m", "raw address mention")
	}
}

func TestRenderBadPaths(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	board(cur)
	bad := []string{
		"nope", "quest", "quest/", "quest/abc", "quest/0", "quest/999", "quest/-1", "quest/1/2", "quest/+1",
		"quest/99999999999999999999999", "quest/1e3", "poster/", "poster/notanaddress",
		"poster/g1jg8mtutu9khhfwc4nxmuhcpftf0pajdhfvsqf6", "builder/<script>", "builder/" + strings.Repeat("g", 500),
		"paid/x", "HELP", "../quest/1", "quest/1#x", "%00", "quest/1\n# injected",
	}
	for _, p := range bad {
		out := renders(t, p)
		has(t, out, "# Not found", "bad path "+p)
		has(t, out, "[Go to the QuestMaster board]("+base+")", "home link "+p)
		hasNot(t, out, "script", "path not echoed "+p)
		hasNot(t, out, "injected", "path not echoed "+p)
	}
	// bad page numbers fall back to page 1 or an empty page, never a panic
	for _, p := range []string{"?page=-5", "?page=0", "?page=abc", "?page=", "?page=1.5", "?%zz", "?page=99999999999999999999"} {
		has(t, renders(t, p), "Page 1 of 2", "page fallback "+p)
	}
	for _, p := range []string{"?page=1000000", "?page=999999999", "paid?page=999", "poster/" + carol.String() + "?page=50"} {
		has(t, renders(t, p), "This page is empty.", "huge page "+p)
	}
	// a valid address with no quests
	has(t, renders(t, "builder/"+testutils.TestAddress("nobody").String()), "No quests yet.", "unknown user")
	// query on a quest page is ignored
	has(t, renders(t, "quest/1?page=2"), "# Quest 1:", "quest with query")
}
